page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a decorative headpiece (no text). Below it, a centred title in capitals and a dedication block, then the greeting "S. P.". Then the body text in full width with a large initial C. The signature ")( ij" is at the foot right. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMO AC FORTISSIMO PRINCIPI, D. IOANNI CASIMIRO, Palatino Rheni, Duci Bauariae, &c. Electoralis Palatinatus Administratori felicissimo, Domino suo clementissimo
main_text.p: CVM ante biennium, Illustrissime Princeps, de chronolo-giae & astronomiae principiis Alfraganū perlegissem; equidem indolui, quod is negligenter versus & pessimè mutilatus in publicum prodiisset. Quamobrem paraphrasin Hebraeam Iacobi Antolii, multis abhinc annis in Alfraganum conscriptam, Lati-nè reddidi; scholiis, quantū fieri potuit, expoliui, totamque calendariorum hi-storiam iusto commentario declaraui.

page.notes: The large initial C is a woodcut and is joined to the first word as "CVM". The "VM" is set in small capitals. The "totámque" in the print carries an accent-like mark that I have read as a simple "totamque"; this is uncertain. Macron on "Alfraganū" and "quantū" is as printed. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens ("chronolo-giae", "Lati-nè", "hi-storiam"). Long s is written as plain s throughout. The ")( ij" signature sits at the foot right.
